insurer: Niva Bupa Health Insurance Company Limited
sumInsured: As per Policy Schedule (Silver/Gold/Platinum; Individual/Family Floater/Family First variants)

great.name: Built-in SI Buffer
great.quote: “We will provide an additional re-fill amount of maximum up to 100% of the Base Sum Insured.”
great.explanation: You get an extra coverage amount equal to 100% of the base Sum Insured once your base SI is exhausted. This gives you additional financial protection within the same policy year.

great.name: Restore Benefit
great.quote: “Re-fill benefit Reinstate up to base Sum Insured. Applicable for same & different illness as well”
great.reference: Annexure II – Product Benefit Table (Silver/Gold/Platinum tables)
great.explanation: Coverage is reinstated up to the base Sum Insured for both same and different illnesses. This means you get stronger protection as repeated claims on the same condition are covered.

good.name: PED Waiting Period
good.quote: “Expenses related to the treatment of a Pre-existing Disease (PED) ... shall be excluded until the expiry of 24 months (under gold & platinum Plans)/ 36 months (under Silver Plans) of continuous coverage”
good.explanation: Pre-existing diseases are excluded for 24 months under Gold/Platinum plans and 36 months under Silver plans. These waiting periods are within the normal market range of 2 to 4 years.

good.name: Initial Waiting Period
good.quote: “Expenses related to the treatment of any Illness within 30 days from the first Policy commencement date shall be excluded except claims arising due to an Accident”
good.explanation: Illnesses are excluded for the first 30 days from policy start, but accidents are covered immediately. This is a standard initial waiting period in the market.

good.name: Specific Illness Waiting
good.quote: “For all Insured Persons who are above 45 years of Age ... Expenses related to the treatment of the listed conditions ... shall be excluded until the expiry of 24 months of continuous coverage”
good.explanation: A 24-month waiting period applies for certain listed diseases and procedures if the insured is above 45 years old. This matches industry standards for specific illness waiting.

good.name: Pre-hospitalization Cover
good.quote: “We will pay ... Pre-hospitalization Medical Expenses only for period up to 60 days immediately preceding the Insured Person’s admission”
good.explanation: Medical expenses incurred up to 60 days before hospital admission are covered. This duration is standard and helps cover diagnostic and treatment costs before hospitalization.

good.name: Post-hospitalization Cover
good.quote: “We will pay Post-hospitalization Medical Expenses only for up to 90 days immediately following the Insured Person’s discharge”
good.explanation: Medical expenses up to 90 days after discharge are covered, which is standard and supports recovery costs after hospitalization.

bad.name: Room Rent
bad.quote: “Room rent Shared Room or 1% of the Base Sum Insured per day”
bad.reference: Annexure II – Product Benefit Table (Individual & Family Floater – Silver Plan)
bad.explanation: Room rent is capped at shared room or 1% of the base Sum Insured per day, which can lead to higher out-of-pocket expenses if you choose a higher room category.

bad.name: Proportionate Deduction
bad.quote: “If the Insured Person is admitted in a Hospital room where the room category opted or Room Rent incurred is higher than the eligibility as specified in the Policy Schedule, then We shall be liable to pay only a pro-rated portion of the total Associated Medical Expenses ... (Eligible Room Rent limit / Room Rent actually incurred) * total Associated Medical Expenses”
bad.explanation: If you choose a room category above your plan’s eligibility, the insurer reduces not only room rent but also associated medical expenses proportionally, increasing your out-of-pocket costs.

bad.name: No Claim Bonus
bad.quote: “Cumulative Bonus means any increase or addition in the Sum Insured granted by the insurer without an associated increase in premium.”
bad.reference: Section 2.5 (Definition only; no non-resetting protection stated)
bad.explanation: The policy offers cumulative bonus but does not protect it from resetting after a claim, so your bonus may reduce or reset, limiting your Sum Insured growth.

bad.name: Consumables
bad.quote: “The expenses that are not covered or subsumed into room charges/ procedure charges/ costs of treatment are mentioned in Annexure VI”
bad.explanation: Many common consumables like gloves and masks are excluded or bundled, which can result in additional out-of-pocket expenses depending on hospital billing.

bad.name: Restore Benefit Limit
bad.quote: “We will provide a re-fill amount only once in a Policy Year.”
bad.explanation: The re-fill benefit is limited to once per policy year, so multiple restorations in a high-claim year are not covered, reducing your coverage flexibility.

bad.name: Co-pay
bad.quote: “The Insured Person will bear a predetermined percentage of the admissible claim amounts subject to the Co-payment option chosen by You in the Proposal Form and / or Information Summary Sheet”
bad.explanation: Co-pay depends on the option selected in your proposal form and policy schedule, so the default co-pay is not clearly stated and must be verified individually.

unclear.name: Cashless Network
unclear.quote: “The complete list of Network Providers is available on Our website and at Our branches”
unclear.explanation: The policy does not specify the number of network hospitals; you should confirm the current cashless network size and availability in your area.

disclaimer: Standard IRDAI exclusions apply. Please verify all details with your insurer or policy document.
